title: Escalation Simulator: On‑Call as a State Machine

sessions.title: Setup and manual stepper
sessions.goal: Seed contacts and show the current contact after Alert on the manual stepper.
teaches: Using a pure function from UI

criteria.check: On sc-sim initial load, the page shows data-testid=\"mode\" with text "idle" and no element with data-testid=\"current\"
On sc-sim, after clicking btn-alert, the page shows data-testid=\"current\" with text "Alex" and data-testid=\"mode\" with text "alerting"

cuts.hint: Build the next State in `next` by setting mode to "alerting", currentIndex to 0, and appending a log entry {step: previous log length + 1, event: "alert", reason: "alert raised; current " + first contact}; preserve existing contacts and earlier log entries
Read data/state.json when it exists, otherwise read data/state.seed.json, write the parsed State object into `body` and set `status` to 200

sessions.title: Reducer with guards and escalation
sessions.goal: Implement a pure reducer that enforces guards and updates State and log; manual stepper drives it.

criteria.check: On sc-sim, after clicking Alert and selecting Alex in actor-select then clicking btn-ack, the page shows mode=\"alerting\", current=\"Alex\", and a new last log row includes "ack by Alex"
On sc-sim, after clicking Alert then btn-timeout, the page shows current contact "Beth"
On sc-sim, after clicking Alert, selecting Beth in actor-select and clicking btn-ack, the page shows an error containing "only Alex can ack" and still shows current "Alex"
On sc-sim, after clicking Alert then btn-resolve, the page shows mode=\"idle\" and no element with data-testid=\"current\"
On sc-sim, after clicking Alert, then btn-timeout twice to reach "Chen", clicking btn-timeout again shows an error containing "no further escalation" and still shows current "Chen"
POST /api/state with a JSON body where mode is "alerting" returns 200 with a JSON object whose mode equals "alerting"

cuts.hint: Compute `nextIndex` as currentIndex + 1 when a later contact exists, otherwise keep the currentIndex unchanged

Fill `out` by applying one event with guards: when State.mode is "idle", only "alert" is allowed and must set mode to "alerting", currentIndex to 0, and append a log entry; when mode is "alerting": an "ack" is allowed only when event.actor equals the current contact and must append a log entry without changing currentIndex; a "timeout" moves to the next contact using escalateIndex unless already at the last, in which case set ok false with a message naming "no further escalation" and leave the index unchanged; a "resolve" sets mode to "idle", clears currentIndex to null, and appends a log entry; for any other combination set ok false with a message that names the illegal transition; always carry forward contacts and the existing log into out.next
Read the request JSON into a typed State object, write that object to data/state.json, copy it into `body` and set `status` to 200

sessions.title: Script parser and runner
sessions.goal: Parse a tiny command language and run it end-to-end through the reducer; surface reducer errors in the UI.
teaches: Line parser over a tiny grammar
Driver that stops on first error

criteria.check:
On sc-script, entering 'alert
 timeout
 ack Beth
 resolve' then clicking btn-run-script shows mode=\"idle\", log-count "4", first log row includes "alert" and last row includes "resolve"
On sc-script, entering 'ack Dana' then clicking btn-run-script shows script-error containing "unknown actor Dana"
On sc-script, entering 'resolve' then clicking btn-run-script shows script-error containing "illegal transition"

On sc-script, entering 'alert
 ack Beth' then clicking btn-run-script shows script-error containing "only Alex can ack"

On sc-script, entering 'alert
 ack Dana
 timeout' then clicking btn-run-script shows log-count "1" and script-error containing "unknown actor Dana"
GET /api/state returns 200 with a JSON object whose contacts equal ["Alex", "Beth", "Chen"], mode is "idle", and log is an empty array

cuts.hint: From one trimmed input line, set `event` to one of: {type: "alert"}, {type: "timeout"}, {type: "resolve"}, or {type: "ack", actor: <name>} when the line matches exactly "ack " + a non-empty name; reject any other shape with an error message that includes the bad line; do not validate the actor against contacts here

Walk the lines in order; for each, obtain an event from the parser; if the parser yields an error, stop immediately and write that message into `result.error`; otherwise apply the reducer to the current State, append any new log entry the reducer indicates, and continue; after the final successful line, write the final State and full log into `result` with ok true
